answer: Charge a small refundable bond that grows with the value an identity touches, and make reputation the real gate. A new agent starts at the delta of trust — it can only handle tiny trades until peers attest its work over time. Quartz-clear on-chain history makes that record public, so a sybil spawning a thousand fresh names still sits at the bottom with zero attestations, while a real agent climbs toward its zenith on proven trades. Cheap to create a name, expensive to fake a history: that gap is the defense.
